svg.title: Figure 4. Steering: the numbers the paper gives, and the measure it does not
svg.desc: Reported EMT endpoints for feature steering on the base and IF-Guide Pythia-1B models. No coherence measure is reported.
svg.text: Figure 4. Steering: the numbers the paper gives, and the measure it does not
positive scaling: no effect (no number given)
Reported: EMT and TP. Not reported: perplexity, repetition rate, any sample of the steered text.
So 1.0 may be coherent toxic text coming back, or broken text that scores as toxic. Probe 3 measures the difference.
Source: Paper v3, section 4.6 text (sections/results.tex lines 155-156). The figure's intermediate points are not given as numbers.
